node: Credentialing, assessment, licensure prep, proctoring, and compliance data
summary: Expanded the credentialing / assessment / compliance-data supply-chain node into a compact two-lane universe. Reference lane: Pearson is the clearest public-market anchor for high-stakes professional assessment and proctoring infrastructure. Underfollowed lane: HealthStream, Graham Holdings, and First Advantage map to narrower chokepoints around healthcare credentialing / CE compliance, professional licensure prep, and employer-side education / credential verification. The strongest chokepoint fit in this pass is HealthStream because its products sit inside regulated healthcare workforce credentialing and compliance workflows rather than broad discretionary education demand.
